Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant application under section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to direct the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lucknow to decide the Case No.43831/2016, arising out of Case Crime No.80 of 2016 (State Versus Satrughan Prasad Maurya and other), under Section 498A, 323504 IPC and 4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Kakori, District Lucknow, within the stipulated period of time as may be fixed by this Court.
